show.description: After 14 years in prison, feared don Bala Shetty returns to Mumbai seeking redemption—only to find his daughter sold into an abusive marriage. As the city closes in, Bala must unleash the monster he buried to reclaim his child, even if it costs him his freedom, his soul, and his last chance at being a father.
